title: openai-compat: multipart file input, content-type validation, and tool/file payload limits
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Motivation: The OpenAI compatibility layer previously accepted file inputs in multiple ad-hoc places which led to inconsistent validation and a few customer incidents (SUP-1789). This PR centralizes multipart/form-data parsing for file inputs, enforces content-type validation and per-file payload limits for tool/function-calling use cases, and tightens error messages to match OpenAI semantics. Summary of changes: 1) Implement multipart/form-data parser in the openai-compat HTTP handler that extracts: 'file' fields for tools, 'files' array for multi-file uploads, and optional 'metadata' fields. 2) Add content-type sniffing with a whitelist for supported types (text/plain, application/json, image/png, image/jpeg, application/pdf) and explicit rejection with OpenAI-style error payloads for unsupported types. 3) Enforce per-file size limits configurable via feature flag and defaulted to 25MB for hosted, 100MB for dedicated/private. 4) Surface clear error responses for streaming and non-streaming endpoints when file validation fails (400 with type and limit details), and add helper utils to map to existing openai-compat error codes. 5) Add integration tests covering multipart uploads, content-type mismatch cases, oversized payloads, and tool-calling path that passes file descriptors through to the tool invocation layer. 6) Docs updates: expand openai-compat.md with examples for multipart uploads and error responses. Checklist: - [x] Implementation of multipart parsing and validation - [x] Unit tests for parser and validators - [x] Integration tests covering streaming and non-streaming endpoints - [x] CI passing (flaky test fixed) - [x] Docs updated - [x] Feature-flag gating for limit values Rollout plan: gated behind openai_compat_file_limits FF. Start in staged rollout on dedicated clusters, monitor error rate and latency for /v1/files and /v1/chat/completions endpoints. Related: PRs that touched file limits and multipart in the past (pr-18432, pr-18456, pr-18563) Implementation notes: parser is implemented as a small middleware invoked only for requests with Content-Type starting with 'multipart/'. It uses the existing streaming body reader to avoid buffering full files into memory for hosted mode. For private deployments we keep the old behavior (configurable) until migration is complete.

release_notes: OpenAI-compat: Add multipart/form-data file input support with content-type validation and configurable per-file payload limits. Returns OpenAI-style error responses for unsupported types and oversized files. Gated behind openai_compat_file_limits feature flag.
notes_for_ops: Gated feature flag defaulted off for hosted initially. For dedicated/private, defaults are higher; ops should monitor 'openai_compat.file_errors' and 'openai_compat.file_upload_latency' dashboards during rollout.
test_matrix: Unit tests for parser/validator, integration tests for streaming and non-streaming paths, e2e test validating OpenAI-style error payloads and tool invocation with file descriptors.
incident_related: Yes - SUP-1789 prompted centralization of validation and clearer error messages.
